facts.text: Under Haverford's student-administered Honor Code, all exams are self-scheduled, and every senior must complete a senior thesis to graduate.

sources.title: Questbridge Application Supplement for 2026-27 - Haverford College
sources.quote: Student ownership is reflected in self-scheduled exams, in the fact that every student completes a Senior Thesis, in shared responsibility for the residential experience, and of course in oversight of the Honor Code itself.
